title: VXAce Looking for Fairytale, Ballroom, Castle, and Clocktower Tilesets

posts.author: BallerinaRu
posts.body:
Hello! This is my first time requesting on here but I'd like to ask, is there any tile sets that are good for the tileset themes I'm requesting?
For my tilesets, I'm going for a gothic Victorian vibe with horror elements inspired by games like pocket mirror, Disney princess enchanted journey, and mickey and the castle of illusion. For the art style of the tilesets, I would prefer Mack to keep the dark theme of it (hopefully it doesn't sound like I'm being demanding)
Fairytale Tileset themes I'm looking for
Alice in Wonderland
- Tilesets that have mushrooms, rose trees and brushes of different cards (like hearts and spades), a table with cookies and tea (similar to 'eat me' and 'drink me', along with giant chess pieces)
Snow White
- I need bigger mirrors, one that could fit a person if they want to go through it, along with cottage tilesets
Cinderella
- For this one it's unique, I want a white palace with a lot of glass tilesets and blue accents like carpets, banners, and carpet stairs
The Snow Queen
- I need an ice palace interior and exterior, along with possibly a winter garden?
Beauty and the Beast
- I need haunted woods along with a dining area
Ballroom tilesets I'm looking for
Tilesets similar to the ballroom in Pocket Mirror or a gothic ballroom with a lot of roses.
Castle Tileset I'm looking for
A gothic castle interior, exterior, and two tiled doors that are preferably black and would fit a gothic castle. Along with some stained glass window tilesets
Clocktower tileset's I'm looking for
Giant Clocks
Small clocks
Gears
If you can find it (and I will be thanking you for the rest of my life) a window reflection that goes to the middle depicting a giant clock as it's shape and shadow.
I'm sorry if my request is really long, I just want to get everything I need out of the way since I spent a long time trying to find tilesets like these. If you need anymore references then I'll be happy to give you them!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
You are asking for a lot of tilesets, where have you looked already? Each of these things you are asking for would probably make for a large enough request at once, and I just want to warn you that while you will likely be able to find a lot of this, you will have to set up the tiles yourself, therefore understand the formats etc.
So while this is doable, this is going to be a long process that requires acquiring a lot of skills on your end, too.
Here are some places you can start with:

aklj00dla.blog.fc2.com
Honestly, there could be a lot more links, but you better build yourself a large resource collection first (important: keep track of the authors and terms of use!) and then just start looking for smaller things you are missing at the moment.
Some more tips:
You might not find the exact things you had in mind, but you will very likely find enough to make a really pretty game with all the settings you need.
Go though this one by one, do your research what's out there and rather make smaller, more detailled requests and be open to try making your own edits. As said, this is very doable, but it will be a lot of work that noone can or will take out of your hands.
The forums here have a lot of links and threads, I know for Ace a lot is down by now, but often using
https://web.archive.org/
can help. Gimp is a free program that will let you manipulate tiles and that will also help you with colorgrading and recoloring, this is where you will be able get a lot closer to your vision if you are willing to invest the time and learn the skills.
Good luck!
